scope.software_validation_definition: The packaged workflow runs, validates inputs, records provenance and preprocessing, emits documented outputs, and passes regression tests.
scope.scientific_validation_definition: The method has suitable independent evidence for the stated scientific claim under comparable samples, acquisition conditions, calibration, references, and uncertainty.
scope.registry_boundary: This registry reports current evidence and blocked claims. It does not promote diagnostic candidates into material, phase, composition, mechanism, performance, or engineering conclusions.

blocked_claims: validated crystallite size without radiation and broadening metadata
analyzers.primary_limitation: The public case lacks complete radiation, instrument, instrumental-broadening, reference-pattern, replicate, and phase-ground-truth evidence.
analyzers.next_required_evidence: Independent reference-material or phase-labelled patterns with complete acquisition metadata, calibration, replicates, and a frozen comparison protocol.

supported_uses: global-threshold region diagnostics on suitable images
blocked_claims: validated particle-size distribution without reference labels and sampling design
analyzers.primary_limitation: The current segmentation is a global Otsu external-contour baseline and the public RWGS image is explicitly blocked for quantitative segmentation because compositional contrast and overlapping agglomerates violate the method assumptions.
analyzers.next_required_evidence: Representative images with acquisition and scale metadata, frozen object definitions, independent region labels or traceable manual measurements, sampling coverage, and inter-reviewer uncertainty.

blocked_claims: validated quantitative composition without standards and correction metadata
analyzers.primary_limitation: The public case lacks standards, correction and geometry metadata, uncertainty, replicate measurements, and an explanation for source-reported Ni that conflicts with the nominal synthesis description.
analyzers.next_required_evidence: Standard- or reference-backed quantitative measurements with detector, voltage, geometry, correction method, uncertainty, replicate, and sampling metadata.

blocked_claims: defect or crystallinity quantification without a validated protocol
analyzers.primary_limitation: The public carbon cases exercise real spectra but do not provide independent assignment ground truth, instrument-transfer validation, controlled replicates, or quantitative reference protocols.
analyzers.next_required_evidence: Reference materials and independently assigned spectra across instruments, replicates, laser conditions, preprocessing sensitivity, and frozen assignment or quantitative protocols.

blocked_claims: element or orbital identification from candidates alone
analyzers.primary_limitation: No independently reviewed component model, sensitivity-factor and transmission correction, reference material, fit uncertainty, or inter-instrument transfer evidence is established.
analyzers.next_required_evidence: Reference spectra and frozen component models with calibration, charge-reference justification, background and line-shape protocol, sensitivity factors, uncertainty, replicates, and independent review.

analyzers.primary_limitation: The real-data workflows do not provide independent band-assignment truth, validated path-length or sampling corrections, reference standards, replicate uncertainty, or transfer evidence.
analyzers.next_required_evidence: Reference materials and frozen assignment or quantification protocols with sampling mode, path length or ATR correction, background, calibration, replicates, and independent review.

blocked_claims: quantitative composition from mass steps alone
analyzers.primary_limitation: The public cases lack independent event assignments, reference standards, blank and buoyancy validation, replicate uncertainty, and a validated kinetic or compositional protocol.
analyzers.next_required_evidence: Reference materials and replicated, calibrated runs with blank or buoyancy handling, atmosphere and flow metadata, frozen event definitions, independent assignments, and uncertainty.

blocked_claims: quantitative enthalpy without complete calibration and mass metadata
analyzers.primary_limitation: The Zr15Nb case lacks exact replicate identity, sample mass, crucible, purge flow, calibration reference, validated baseline, independent event review, and a quantitative enthalpy protocol.
analyzers.next_required_evidence: Replicated reference-backed DSC with complete sample, pan, purge, calibration and baseline metadata, frozen onset and enthalpy methods, independent event assignments, and uncertainty.

supported_uses: fail-closed external-validation intake and readiness contracts
blocked_claims: automatic particle, phase, defect, pore, grain, or lattice-feature identity
model retraining justified by external evidence
analyzers.primary_limitation: No independent raw or demonstrably lossless in-domain Co3O4 TEM or HRTEM cohort with authoritative sample and acquisition lineage, blinded labels, content disjointness, and model-development non-use has passed intake.
analyzers.next_required_evidence: Acquire at least two independent Co3O4 samples and acquisitions with raw or lossless images, immutable lineage, calibration, reuse rights, two blinded labelers plus adjudicated consensus, overlap audits, and a frozen evaluation protocol.

supported_uses: fail-closed source, transfer, intake, and protocol contracts
blocked_claims: reflection, phase, structure, or zone-axis assignment
calibrated d-spacing accuracy against independent ground truth
analyzers.primary_limitation: No independent checksum-bound raw or demonstrably lossless static-SAED cohort with authoritative centre, reciprocal calibration, material and acquisition identity, frozen references, and analyzer-development non-use has passed intake.
analyzers.next_required_evidence: Acquire at least two independent calibrated static-SAED patterns or acquisitions with raw or lossless intensity, immutable lineage, detector and voltage metadata, traceable centre and reciprocal calibration, frozen references, overlap review, and a predeclared protocol.
